summary: Context window as a 200-cell waffle, one cell per thousand tokens; attached files fly in and compacting crumbles the conversation.

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when cells are added. `used` is the number of filled cells, in thousands of tokens.

events.name: compact
events.description: Fires after compacting, with the new number of filled cells.

methods.description: Adds cells to a source (0 System prompt, 1 Tools, 2 Files, 3 Conversation), up to the 200-cell limit, and fires `change`. When full, the grid shakes and nothing is added. An unknown category or a count below one is ignored; counts are rounded.
Keeps a quarter of the Conversation cells (at least 8), crumbles the rest and fires `compact`. Does nothing if there is nothing to remove.

accessibility: The canvas has `role="img"` with an `aria-label` such as "Context window 110k of 200k tokens used", updated on every change.
The total above the grid is an `aria-live="polite"` region.
Legend entries are focusable (`tabindex="0"`); focusing one isolates its source, as hover does.
motion: With reduced motion, cells jump into place instead of flying and a full grid does not shake; compacted cells still crumble away.
notes: The starting usage is built-in demo data: System prompt 6k, Tools 14k, Files 38k and Conversation 52k, 110k in total.
The host carries `data-zone="ok"`, `"warn"` from 160 cells or `"full"` from 190 cells.
The grid is 20 cells wide on a 164px tall canvas.

data.note: The starting context usage per source is invented; `add()` and `compact()` change it but it cannot be set.
